## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `feat/revrook-ce-<phase or topic>` and the pull request targets `development` (or its stacked parent branch)
- [ ] CI `Merge gate summary` is green on the head commit; a skipped check is not a pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or real client data committed
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned and their licences are compatible with MIT (NOTICE updated if needed)
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour or workflow changed
- [ ] Any statement about output keeps the wording: configuration evidence summary, not a certification, audit or legal advice
- [ ] No claim of customers, certification or availability was added
- [ ] Reviewed by someone other than the author
